patch.value: Gated sync still refuses duplicate GH278 provenance across two delivered records

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-web#288 (filed 2026-11-01, missed by the blind issue watch). The scheduled gated sync on current main still fails with 'import plan is not idempotent — 1 duplicate provenance tag(s)': two distinct closed records (the cited-evidence inspection feature and the SDK evidence-fragments issue) both carry the gh: tag for PR #278, which is a unique importer provenance key, so PR #278 legitimately linking both deliveries breaks the plan. Latest failing run 41407648593 (2026-11-02T07:38Z); failures repeat daily since 11-01. Reconcile to exactly one canonical import identity while preserving both records' delivery evidence: keep the tag on the record the issue/PR primarily tracks and convert the other link to a structured relationship or dependency (no second gh: tag). A bounded scan found this single repeated key in the tracker corpus.

## Observed failure and immutable source

At default-branch commit `6061e4d2a0657a80b340a6009e9f00075f1e66fa`, the [gated-sync run 41284979499, job 124784357076](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/actions/runs/41284979499/job/124784357076) resolved **pm-github 2026.10.19** and failed at 2026-11-01 07:29:58 UTC:

```text
pm github gate: import plan is not idempotent — 1 duplicate provenance tag(s) in the existing corpus, 0 new entr(y/ies) without a provenance tag, 0 conflicting target(s). No item was written.
```

This is hosted execution evidence plus independently inspected static source, not a local rerun or a claim of lost data.

These distinct closed PM records both contain `tags[1]: "gh:unbraind/pm-web#278"`:
- [pm-web-5sx6: Inspect cited evidence freshness and affected criteria](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/6061e4d2a0657a80b340a6009e9f00075f1e66fa/.agents/pm/features/pm-web-5sx6.toon)
- [pm-web-cnhi: Expose current evidence fragments through the supported SDK](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/6061e4d2a0657a80b340a6009e9f00075f1e66fa/.agents/pm/issues/pm-web-cnhi.toon)

[PR278](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/278) legitimately links both delivered records. Sharing implementation evidence is not itself wrong; the problem is using the same unique importer provenance key for both canonical records. A bounded static scan of all 193 tracker `.toon` files at this commit found this one repeated `gh:` key, consistent with the hosted gate's count.

## Expected / actual and impact

The repository's [gated-sync adoption](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/204) is intended to synchronize GitHub issue state through a safe, idempotent plan. Expected: an unambiguous canonical import identity while preserving all related PM work and delivery evidence. Actual: the existing corpus is rejected before any write, blocking the sync workflow.

The refusal is protective. Do not weaken or bypass it, delete either valid PM record/history, discard delivery references, or infer arbitrary provider ownership. This report does not establish a visitor-facing regression, publication failure, or data loss.

## Acceptance / regression criteria

- Reconcile GH278 to one supported canonical importer identity while retaining both PM records, histories, release metadata and meaningful PR/delivery links.
- At the repaired immutable HEAD, verify the exact-version read-only import plan/preflight reports zero duplicate provenance, zero missing provenance and zero conflicting targets.
- Repeat planning and verify idempotency/no additional changes; retain a negative-control fixture proving duplicated identity still fails closed without writes.
- Record HEAD, exact commands/results and subsequent outcome of the normal authorized gated workflow. Keep any workflow-version upgrade separate from metadata repair; no assumption that upgrading from .10.19 fixes this corpus.
- Preserve existing privacy boundaries and fail-closed gates.

## Dedup and verification limits

Reviewed all 287 all-status repository issues/PRs, all 193 canonical tracker records, PR278 conversation and 26 repository issue comments since October29. No existing dedicated repair item or report for this duplicate-provenance refusal was found. Open workflow bumps #286/#287 concern version pins, not this identity reconciliation.

Only read-only source inspection and hosted logs were used; no original edits, migrations, provider writes or local importer execution. The run remained completed/failure at the same immutable HEAD when rechecked before filing.
